_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: As Built Configuration List - Common (ABCL-C)
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for the As-Built Configuration List-Common (ABCL-C), which documents hardware and software configuration items for an end item as delineated in the contract.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

It is not intended that all the requirements herein should be applied to every program. Portions of this DID are subject to tailoring by deletion depending on the specific status reporting requirements of the project.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: As-built configuration list format shall be an electronic comma separated variables (csv). Each text file shall contain 23 columns describing the attributes of each hardware and software configuration item for a single end item.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The ABCL-C shall contain all of the information identified in Table 1 of this DID and the following information:

children.title: Columns 1 and 2
children.content: Columns 1 and 2 shall describe the program and shall be the same for all rows.

children.title: Columns 3 through 18
children.content: Columns 3 through 18 shall describe each reportable item. Rows are repeated for each unique combination of columns 21 through 23.

children.title: Columns 19 and 20
children.content: Columns 19 and 20 shall describe the end item and will be the same for all rows.

children.title: Columns 21 through 23
children.content: Columns 21 through 23 describe messages related to each reportable item. The number of unique messages for an item can range from 0 to 99. The first row of each message contains a message label in column 21, column 22 is blank and column 23 contains the number "1".

children.title: Row one
children.content: Row one shall contain information for the end item (the highest level assembly in the file). Column 10 for this row is always the number "0".

children.title: The report shall identify the end item
children.content: The report shall identify the end item as the highest level assembly in the deliverable file.

children.title: Item
children.content: Item shall be identified as a unique reportable individual missile, section, assembly, or component.

children.title: NHA
children.content: NHA shall be identified as the Next Higher Assembly of an item.

children.title: Manufacturer
children.content: Manufacturer shall be identified by indicating the specific vendor that produced the reportable item.

children.title: CAGE Code
children.content: CAGE Code shall be identified as Commercial and Government Entity Code.

children.title: CARL
children.content: CARL shall be identified as the Configuration Accounting Requirements List. A collection of hierarchical configuration structures (indentured drawing trees) for each end item part number produced under the contract. The drawing tree for each end item part number will contain an indentured list of primary and alternate reportable part numbers. Additional configuration data delivery requirements may also be documented.
